name: North Dakota
talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 1 solo PCPs winding down in North Dakota, several with no local backup — drive-time gap risk.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~431 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 0 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~3,600 patients across 3 at-risk practices statewide.
